name: Bar Fight with Michael Knowles
overview: Buckle up for Bar Fight: with Michael Knowles as Knowles goes head-to-head with challengers from across the aisle in a no-holds-barred, high-energy debate show. With a rowdy live audience choosing the topics and even jumping into the action at the “Fight Mic,” you never know what will happen next. If you’re ready for a real fight over real ideas, it’s time for Bar Fight.
